name: @cytoscape-web/network-statistics
description: Logs network topology statistics (density, degree distribution, roots, leaves) to the browser console on every network switch. A non-React example using only mount/unmount lifecycle hooks.
//cyweb: This app's identity, written ONCE. The federation container name, the
CyApp.id and the dev install manifest all read from here — before this
block they were three hand-synced string literals with no import between
them, and nothing noticed a mismatch until the host refused to load.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json

//peerDependencies: Deliberately absent. This app shares NOTHING with the host: it has no UI
and imports neither React nor MUI, so there are no singletons to declare.
//devDependencies: @types/react is required even though no runtime code touches React: the
published @cytoscape-web/api-types declarations reference React types, so
`tsc` needs them to resolve. Removing it looks like a tidy-up and breaks
